rows.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN case_number = 0 THEN 'none' WHEN case_number <= 4 THEN '1_to_4' ELSE '5_or_more' END AS precedent_band, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, SUM(CASE WHEN first_judge = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_judge_count FROM legal WHERE case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY precedent_band
SELECT evidence, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE evidence IS NOT NULL GROUP BY evidence

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, COUNT(*) AS case_count, SUM(CASE WHEN verdict = 'Dismissed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant != '' GROUP BY applicant_nation

SELECT CASE WHEN legal_basis_num = 0 THEN 'none' WHEN legal_basis_num = 1 THEN 'one' WHEN legal_basis_num <= 3 THEN 'two_or_three' ELSE 'four_or_more' END AS statute_band, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal GROUP BY statute_band
SELECT judgment_year, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY judgment_year

SELECT CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents, SUM(CASE WHEN evidence = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS evidence_count FROM legal WHERE defendant_current_status != '' AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY defendant_family

SELECT CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Commercial Case' AND case_number >= 3 GROUP BY verdict_family
SELECT judgment_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Commercial Case' AND legal_basis_num >= 2 AND judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY judgment_year

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant != '' GROUP BY applicant_nation, verdict_family
SELECT judgment_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY judgment_year
SELECT CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal GROUP BY verdict_family

SELECT CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE defendant_current_status != '' GROUP BY defendant_family, verdict_family
SELECT first_judge, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Civil Case' AND judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2008 GROUP BY first_judge

SELECT CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE defendant_current_status != '' GROUP BY defendant_family

SELECT judge_name, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE judge_name != '' AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY judge_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant != '' GROUP BY applicant_nation, case_family
SELECT judgment_year, MAX(legal_basis_num) AS max_statutes FROM legal WHERE judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY judgment_year

SELECT CASE WHEN plaintiff_current_status IN ('Company', 'Organization', 'Government') THEN plaintiff_current_status WHEN plaintiff_current_status != '' THEN 'Individual_or_other' END AS plaintiff_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents, SUM(CASE WHEN verdict = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count FROM legal WHERE plaintiff_current_status != '' AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY plaintiff_family

SELECT judge_name, COUNT(*) AS case_count, SUM(CASE WHEN verdict = 'Dismissed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed_count, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE judge_name IN ('Flick', 'Tracey', 'Greenwood', 'Marshall', 'Moore', 'Heerey', 'Spender', 'Rares') AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY judge_name

SELECT judgment_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents, SUM(CASE WHEN evidence = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS evidence_count FROM legal WHERE judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY judgment_year

SELECT judgment_year, CASE WHEN case_type = 'Administrative Case' THEN 'Administrative' ELSE 'non_administrative' END AS case_group, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY judgment_year, case_group

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Administrative Case' AND verdict = 'Dismissed' AND nationality_for_applicant != '' GROUP BY applicant_nation

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Administrative Case' AND nationality_for_applicant != '' GROUP BY applicant_nation

SELECT evidence, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents, MAX(case_number) AS max_precedents FROM legal WHERE evidence IS NOT NULL AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY evidence

SELECT CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, CASE WHEN legal_basis_num >= 3 THEN 'statute_heavy' ELSE 'statute_light' END AS statute_band, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE defendant_current_status != '' GROUP BY defendant_family, statute_band
SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal GROUP BY case_family
SELECT hearing_year, judgment_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE hearing_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 AND judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY hearing_year, judgment_year

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, evidence, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE evidence IS NOT NULL GROUP BY case_family, evidence

SELECT CASE WHEN plaintiff_current_status IN ('Company', 'Organization', 'Government') THEN plaintiff_current_status WHEN plaintiff_current_status != '' THEN 'Individual_or_other' END AS plaintiff_family, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE plaintiff_current_status != '' GROUP BY plaintiff_family, verdict_family

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant != '' GROUP BY applicant_nation

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal GROUP BY case_family
SELECT evidence, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE legal_basis_num BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND case_number >= 4 GROUP BY evidence

SELECT CASE WHEN legal_basis_num = 0 THEN 'none' WHEN legal_basis_num <= 2 THEN '1_or_2' ELSE '3_or_more' END AS statute_band, CASE WHEN case_number = 0 THEN 'no_precedents' ELSE 'has_precedents' END AS precedent_status, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY statute_band, precedent_status

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, first_judge, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE first_judge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY case_family, first_judge

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant != '' AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY applicant_nation

SELECT CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE legal_basis_num >= 3 AND defendant_current_status != '' GROUP BY defendant_family

SELECT hearing_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, MAX(case_number) AS max_precedents, SUM(CASE WHEN verdict = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count FROM legal WHERE hearing_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hearing_year

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India') GROUP BY case_family

SELECT CASE WHEN case_number = 0 THEN 'none' WHEN case_number <= 4 THEN '1_to_4' ELSE '5_or_more' END AS precedent_band, case_type, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY precedent_band, case_type

SELECT hearing_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count, MIN(legal_basis_num) AS min_statutes, MAX(legal_basis_num) AS max_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE hearing_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hearing_year
SELECT evidence, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Administrative Case' AND verdict = 'Dismissed' AND judgment_year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008 GROUP BY evidence

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal GROUP BY case_family, verdict_family
SELECT judge_name, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Administrative Case' AND verdict = 'Dismissed' GROUP BY judge_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE verdict IN ('Approved', 'Others') AND defendant_current_status != '' GROUP BY defendant_family
SELECT judge_name, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE judge_name != '' GROUP BY judge_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
SELECT evidence, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE evidence IS NOT NULL AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY evidence

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY case_family

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, evidence, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant != '' AND evidence IS NOT NULL GROUP BY applicant_nation, evidence

SELECT CASE WHEN defendant IN ('Minister for Immigration and Citizenship', 'Minister for Immigration and Multicultural Affairs', 'Minister for Immigration and Multicultural and Indigenous Affairs', 'Commissioner of Taxation') THEN defendant WHEN defendant <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE defendant <> '' GROUP BY applicant_nation, verdict_family

SELECT CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE plaintiff = 'Cadbury Schweppes Pty Ltd' AND case_number >= 3 GROUP BY verdict_family

SELECT CASE WHEN counsel_for_respondent IN ('Mr T Reilly', 'Ms V McWilliam', 'C Golvan SC || S Ricketson', 'G Kennett') THEN counsel_for_respondent WHEN counsel_for_respondent <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE counsel_for_respondent <> '' AND NOT case_number IS NULL GROUP BY applicant_nation

SELECT judgment_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE counsel_for_respondent = 'C Golvan SC || S Ricketson' AND legal_basis_num >= 2 AND judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY judgment_year

SELECT CASE WHEN case_number = 0 THEN 'none' WHEN case_number <= 4 THEN '1_to_4' ELSE '5_or_more' END AS precedent_band, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, SUM(CASE WHEN first_judge = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_judge_count FROM legal WHERE NOT case_number IS NULL AND legal_fees >= 2800 GROUP BY precedent_band

SELECT CASE WHEN plaintiff IN ('Australian Competition and Consumer Commission', 'Australian Securities and Investments Commission', 'Cadbury Schweppes Pty Ltd') THEN plaintiff ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal GROUP BY verdict_family

SELECT defendant, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE defendant BETWEEN 'Minister for Immigration and Multicultural Affairs' AND 'Minister for Immigration and Multicultural and Indigenous Affairs' GROUP BY defendant

SELECT first_judge, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Civil Case' AND plaintiff BETWEEN 'Australian Competition and Consumer Commission' AND 'Australian Competition and Consumer Commission' GROUP BY first_judge

SELECT CASE WHEN case_number = 0 THEN 'none' WHEN case_number <= 4 THEN '1_to_4' ELSE '5_or_more' END AS precedent_band, defendant, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE defendant IN ('Minister for Immigration and Citizenship', 'Minister for Immigration and Multicultural Affairs', 'Minister for Immigration and Multicultural and Indigenous Affairs') AND NOT case_number IS NULL GROUP BY precedent_band, defendant

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE counsel_for_respondent = 'Ms V McWilliam' AND verdict = 'Dismissed' AND nationality_for_applicant <> '' GROUP BY applicant_nation
SELECT legal_fees, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE NOT legal_fees IS NULL AND NOT case_number IS NULL GROUP BY legal_fees

SELECT hearing_year, CASE WHEN legal_basis_num <= 1 THEN '0_or_1' WHEN legal_basis_num <= 3 THEN '2_or_3' ELSE '4_or_more' END AS statute_band, COUNT(*) AS case_count, defendant FROM legal WHERE hearing_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY hearing_year, statute_band, defendant

SELECT judge_name, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, AVG(legal_fees) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE judge_name <> '' AND NOT legal_fees IS NULL GROUP BY judge_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

SELECT judgment_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(fine_amount) AS avg_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents, SUM(CASE WHEN evidence = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS evidence_count FROM legal WHERE judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 AND NOT case_number IS NULL GROUP BY judgment_year

SELECT CASE WHEN counsel_for_respondent IN ('Mr T Reilly', 'Ms V McWilliam', 'C Golvan SC || S Ricketson') THEN counsel_for_respondent WHEN counsel_for_respondent <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE counsel_for_respondent <> '' GROUP BY defendant_family
SELECT evidence, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE NOT evidence IS NULL AND counsel_for_applicant LIKE '%azzi%' GROUP BY evidence
